integrity: Claim is derived from a constructive component decomposition and analytic arguments. Supplementary finite checker is explicitly not an infinite proof. No independent review or historical priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed number q of exhaustive colours; directed partial injections; ordinary first-order formulas; uniform unlabelled sampling. General saddle-point asymptotics and Hanf locality used as established tools; prior equivalent general theorem remains a historical risk, especially inaccessible Compton 1987 full text.
title: A sharp rational first-order limit law for unlabelled coloured partial injections
